mapper.update: INSERT INTO store(name, address, status) SELECT DISTINCT CONCAT('门店-', LEFT(receiver_address, 10)) AS name, receiver_address, 1 FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM store s WHERE s.address = o.receiver_address )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, name, address, phone, lng, lat, business_hours, status FROM store ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT id, name, address, phone, lng, lat, business_hours, status FROM store WHERE (lng IS NULL OR lat IS NULL) AND address IS NOT NULL AND address != '' ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, name, address, phone, lng, lat, business_hours, status FROM store WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store(name, address, phone, lng, lat, business_hours, status) VALUES(#{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{businessHours}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE store SET name = #{name}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, lng = #{lng}, lat = #{lat}, business_hours = #{businessHours}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
